title: Nexus PackExportResponse
description: Response for POST /v1/daemon/worlds/:world_id/kb/pack/export (V1.152 P0 DF-77). The Narrative Knowledge Pack envelope (spoke handbook domain-profile-narrative-knowledge-pack). Entries and relations are opaque spoke objects (V1.139 fallback).

modules.description: modules.pack catalog metadata plus any unknown modules.* dialect keys (round-trip verbatim).

items.description: Spoke KnowledgeEntry (serialized JSON object). Typed access is via the spoke package (@42ch/spoke-schemas / spoke-schemas). Canonical schema: https://spoke42.invalid/schemas/data/knowledge-entry.schema.json. V1.139 fallback: opaque object here.
Spoke Relation (serialized JSON object). Canonical schema: https://spoke42.invalid/schemas/data/relation.schema.json. V1.139 fallback: opaque object here.

source_anchors.description: Optional SourceAnchor list (present only when include_anchors is set on the request).
